svg.text: SAFETY: 120 V work must be GFCI protected and done/inspected by a licensed electrician to local code. The controller PCB carries 12 V DC only.
or 20 A breaker + GFCI at coop

ESP32-DevKitC-32E + ESPHome. Cable glands on the bottom face only
